description: Scaffolds standard project folder structures and initializes Git repositories.
author: Charon Librarian

system_cleaner_initialize.description: Creates a structured project workspace directory with default subfolders and initial Git tracking.

project_name.description: Name of the new project workspace.

base_path.description: Parent directory where project will be scaffolded.

subdirectories.description: Custom subfolders to create. Defaults to ['cad', 'firmware', 'docs', 'src', 'bom'].

initialize_git.description: Whether to run git init on the new directory. Defaults to true.
